title: a fetch step its holder's connector cannot ask is run like a search step, not sent to the browser
line: a fetch step whose holder's connector has nothing to ask from the citation's details (the city directories at K01 want a town) is logged none there, the note naming the field wanted, off the fetch list and the queue, on the person's screen for a hand; a turn does not pause on it

steps.say: a fetch step at K01 (Internet Archive city directories, data/holders.csv dbid 2469) on a real person, its citation carrying the collection and the name alone: no town of the person's, as the live catalog's own instance of this (Abraham B Brant, citation 1,2469::161249030) has it. That person and citation are outside the cut harness tree, so this step is planted by hand on a person the harness does carry, exactly as tools/plan.py would generate it from such a citation.

expect.why: the runner takes a fetch step whose holder has a connector, whether or not it currently has anything to ask

steps.say: run it: no town in the fields, so ia_directories has nothing to ask and no request goes out

expect.why: logged like a search step whose connector has nothing to ask, no request sent

notes.has: a town the person lived in

expect.why: a none run with no request, the note naming the field the connector wants
a none run leaves the step planned, for a hand on the person's screen
off the queue: the source has answered on these very fields

steps.say: off the fetch list too: the holder has a connector, so this step was never sent to the browser

expect.why: a holder with a connector is never on the browser's own fetch list, whether or not it currently has anything to ask

steps.say: the plan writes the field it wanted (a town from an accepted residence): the step is asked again

expect.why: new fields: the connector may have something to ask now
